parts: Authored upstream models, including upstream bear breed definitions for panda, red panda and raccoon.
markings: Upstream boundaries and surface sampling in part-local 3D coordinates.
adaptations: Original proportions and palettes retained except for documented local refinements. Dog face is raised per upstream renderer; other muzzle-bearing heads use small eye-placement corrections to prevent occlusion. Local matte art direction and alpaca/sheep/parrot refinements are applied by pet_character_refinements.mjs.
